dct_description_sm: It is the responsibility of the Government of the Northwest Territories (GNWT) to provide consumption advice for country foods that are important to people in the NWT.  An objective of this project was to create a mechanism that will validate the necessity of continuing with a consumption advisory once it has been issued.  Ongoing monitoring needs to be in place for at-risk lakes that are heavily fished so that when levels of mercury in fish in a particular lake rise above a safe limit, responsible decision-makers can be made immediately aware and act in a timely manner.
dct_title_s: Temporal trends of mercury levels of fish in lakes with out-dated health advisories in the Northwest Territories, Canada
